mappingNotes: Official awards are retained separately; no university-specific canonical course is created.
CSE specialisations use the existing appropriate computing parent; CSBS uses CSE.
VLSI and embedded systems map to postgraduate ECE; Structural to postgraduate Civil; Engineering Design to postgraduate Mechanical.
SREC M.Tech Nano Science and Technology maps to the existing postgraduate Materials family, whose aliases include M.Tech Nanotechnology.
Aeronautical maps to the existing aerospace parent; no doctorate gap is treated as a new undergraduate or masters course.
